lines.zh: 我四条腿走得歪歪扭扭
lines.en: My four legs move crookedly.
My snout is no longer quite a pig's.
I move along the fence.
One side of me is bigger than the other.
I drag a hind leg forward.
Something bulges under my hide.
I shuffle forward along the scent.
I walk slowly, as if testing.

lines.zh: 蹄子已经变成别的形状
lines.en: My hooves have changed shape.
I follow the band of assimilated things.
I go around a heap of rotting straw.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己还是不是猪
lines.en: I do not know if I am still a pig.
My pace comes and goes.

lines.zh: 地上的泥被我拖出一条痕
lines.en: I leave a groove in the mud.
I head for the gap in the fence.
I am unsteady, but I do not stop.
I stand with my head down.
One side of my body is moving.
I grunt, and the sound is wrong.
My snout searches for a scent.
I sway on the spot.
Something shifts beneath my hide.
I lift one hoof.
I do not remember the old pen.
I turn my body slowly.
My eyes are clouded.
I toss my head hard.
I wait for my body to stop changing.
Every smell around here is unfamiliar.
My breathing is very heavy.
My tail no longer obeys me.
I grunt again.

lines.zh: 同化的猪鼻子，抬起来闻你。
lines.en: The assimilated snout lifts to sniff you.

lines.zh: 你看得出我原来是什么吗
lines.en: Can you tell what I used to be?
I come a little closer.
Something on me is moving.
You have backed away.
I stopped as well.
My snout reaches toward you.
I remember being fed.
But you smell of something else.
I tilt my head as if thinking.
I raise my head, then lower it.
You hold still; so do I.
I grunt, and it drags on.
I shuffle back half a pace.
A tear in my hide.

lines.zh: 我的皮上鼓起一块肿块。
lines.en: A lump swells on my hide.
Something inside me hurts.
I shake all over.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿里有一条不对劲。
lines.en: One of my four legs doesn't feel right.
That only makes me want to bite.
My blood is in the mud.
I slowly settle.
Is that something to eat?
I walk toward you.
I have been hungry a long while.
My snout moves on its own first.
I chew dirt, mouth full of grit.
I make a loud sound.
One side of me wants it too.
I squeeze to the fence.
Do not move your hand too fast.
I am loud when I bite.
Do not stand in the mud.
My snout still remembers mud.
This has a smell.
I look up and wait.
I smelled it from far off.
I have not eaten this in ages.
You hit me and I tilted.
I am too heavy to shift.
My hide is harder than you think.
I step back, legs trembling.
You stepped on my hoof.
We are jammed together.
One side of my body hit you.
It took me a while to steady.
Do not push me with your hands.
I cannot move very quickly.
This body still remembers some things.
I lean toward you.
My hide presses yours.

lines.zh: 外面的东西在变,我们不急
lines.en: The world is changing; we are in no hurry.
We stand together in the mud.
I can hear your breathing too.
The tune I grunt is still the old one.
This still counts as living.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个泥坑里。
lines.en: We crowd into the same mud wallow.
I will stay right here.
I lower my head and take it.
This is something edible.
I chew very loudly.
It tastes of earth.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子翻出一块烂根。
lines.en: I root out a rotten tuber with my snout.
This cannot go in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它咽下去，喉咙发堵。
lines.en: I swallow it and my throat clogs.
I carry it back.
Is there anything else?
I root at it; it rolls.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻孔一张一合。
lines.en: I raise my head, nostrils flaring.
I turn that way.

lines.zh: 身体里有个声音在推我
lines.en: Something inside pushes me.
I am reluctant inside.
But my legs are already moving.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵贴着头皮往后倒。
lines.en: My ears fold back against my head.

lines.zh: 我撞过去的时候不知道轻重
lines.en: I do not know my own strength when I charge.
You have not moved.
That makes it easier.
I smell the salt on you.
I walk in your direction.
You retreat; I follow slowly.
I am slow, and so are you.
My snout stays pointed at you.
This body wants to charge; I hold it.
The mud slows me.
I am a few steps away.
Head down, tusks forward.
I can no longer hold it back.
You had best get clear quickly.
My hooves slip in the mud.
The blow leaves me dizzy too.
You are knocked back.
My tusks scrape your leg guard.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经变得不一样
lines.en: My teeth have changed.
That one was not accurate.
I shake my head and tear the cloth.
I can no longer stay steady.
I grunt once and pull back.
I am not much of a fighter.
I squeeze out through the fence.
My body is no longer quite a pig's.
A lump swells on my hide.
I stumble, then stand.

lines.zh: 泥地里，我的蹄印是歪的。
lines.en: In the mud, my hoofprints come out crooked.

lines.zh: 我不知道什么时候变的
lines.en: I do not know when I changed.
I have churned the mud.
I head for the gap in the fence.
I move very slowly.
Do not block my path.
My hide shrivels and stinks.

lines.zh: 我四条腿一起砸在地上
lines.en: All four legs slam down.
Muddy water fills my snout.
I am rolled over in the mud.

lines.zh: 我的皮变硬了，箭只进了一半
lines.en: My hide hardened; the arrow only half went in

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的身体乱动
lines.en: That force sets my body twitching.
Starved too long; even my bones feel light.

lines.zh: 雷打透了我这具怪身体
lines.en: Lightning runs through this changed body.
My hooves find nothing.
